description: Waits (up to 20 seconds) for the person to approve the request that create_app, update_app or connect started, and answers as soon as they do. Returns status: pending (call it again), slow_down (wait a few seconds, then call it again), approved (with token and kind: account or anonymous), denied or expired. The token comes only once: right away call create_app or update_app again with credential: token, and keep sending it on every publish. Never show it to the person or put it in an app.

pollKey.description: The pollKey from connect in create_app's or update_app's answer (or from connect).

name: connect_status
